sentences.en: Thousands of hectares of tropical rainforest are being lost every day.
sentences.zh: 每天都有成千上万公顷的热带雨林在消失。

sentences.en: He inherited some hectares of land from his grandfather.
sentences.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了一些公顷的土地。

sentences.en: He has almost fourteen hectares of vines in Algeria.
sentences.zh: 他在阿尔及利亚有将近十四公顷的葡萄园。
